information: #### This competition only features FMC (3x3x3 Fewest Moves) #### All 3 rounds (9 attempts) will be done in 1 full day, with short breaks between attempts and meal breaks between rounds. Please plan accordingly to ensure you will be present in time for each attempt. As a result, this competition is not recommended for those looking for a typical competition experience. However, new competitors are still welcome to sign up :) Please consider instead any of the many [other competitions happening in Ohio](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). All competitors who attend will receive a special "I Survived Ohio State Mental Madness 2024" pen. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcjVrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--be1ed8786c264b5259bf0462861b4504cd7b07d5/image.png)
